name: Reliability
description: Maintain service reliability, safety, incident response, and long-term product health with measurable evidence.

members.role: Default — triage, diagnosis, remediation, automation, and operational ownership
Default peer lane or alternate responder; never self-review
Default — reproduce incidents and independently verify fixes and regressions
Optional second independent security or high-severity verification lane
Optional — prioritize product impact, maintenance tradeoffs, and user communication
Optional — investigate and verify recurring UX failures

entry_criteria: An incident, defect pattern, reliability risk, maintenance obligation, or product-health regression needs an owner
exit_criteria: Service health is restored or risk is explicitly accepted
recurrence controls and owners are recorded
